# YAPP router register map

<!-- generated by scripts/project_map/build.py from scripts/project_map/regmap.yaml -- edit the YAML and run `make map`; do not edit this file -->

The router's host port (HBUS) has a 16-bit address and 8-bit data: every address holds one byte. The RTL is `yapp_project/rtl/yapp_hbus_regs.sv`; the full specification with the protocols and timing diagrams is [spec.md](spec.md).

## Registers

| Address | Name | Access | Reset | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `0x1000` | `ctrl_reg` | RW | `0x3f` | Control: maximum payload length |
| `0x1001` | `en_reg` | RW | `0x01` | Enables: router and the six counters |
| `0x1004` | `parity_err_cnt_reg` | RO | `0x00` | packets received with bad parity |
| `0x1005` | `oversized_pkt_cnt_reg` | RO | `0x00` | packets longer than maxpktsize |
| `0x1006` | `addr3_cnt_reg` | RO | `0x00` | packets to the illegal address 3 |
| `0x1009` | `addr0_cnt_reg` | RO | `0x00` | packets to address 0 |
| `0x100a` | `addr1_cnt_reg` | RO | `0x00` | packets to address 1 |
| `0x100b` | `addr2_cnt_reg` | RO | `0x00` | packets to address 2 |
| `0x100d` | `mem_size_reg` | RO | `0x00` | payload length of the last packet received |

## Fields of the read-write registers

### `ctrl_reg` (0x1000)

| Bits | Field | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [5:0] | `maxpktsize` | maximum payload length (RAL name plen) |
| [7:6] | `unused` | unused, RW |

### `en_reg` (0x1001)

| Bits | Field | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [0] | `router_en` | router enable: 0 drops every packet |
| [1] | `parity_err_cnt_en` | count packets with bad parity |
| [2] | `oversized_pkt_cnt_en` | count packets longer than maxpktsize |
| [3] | `reserved` | not implemented |
| [4] | `addr0_cnt_en` | count packets to address 0 |
| [5] | `addr1_cnt_en` | count packets to address 1 |
| [6] | `addr2_cnt_en` | count packets to address 2 |
| [7] | `addr3_cnt_en` | count packets to the illegal address 3 |

## Memories

| Addresses | Name | Size | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `0x1010` .. `0x104f` | `yapp_pkt_mem` | 64 bytes | RO | bytes of the last packet received: [0] header, [1..63] payload |
| `0x1100` .. `0x11ff` | `yapp_mem` | 256 bytes | RW | scratch memory |

## Unmapped addresses

A read returns `0x00`; a write is ignored. Inside the window:

- `0x1002` .. `0x1003`
- `0x1007` .. `0x1008`
- `0x100c`
- `0x100e` .. `0x100f`
- `0x1050` .. `0x10ff`

## What a read and a write do

| Access | RW register / `yapp_mem` | RO register / `yapp_pkt_mem` | Unmapped |
|---|---|---|---|
| Write | stores the byte | ignored | ignored |
| Read | the stored byte | the current value | `0x00` |

The counters count only while `router_en` (`en_reg[0]`) is 1 and their own enable bit is set, and wrap from 255 to 0. `mem_size_reg` and `yapp_pkt_mem` describe the last packet received while the router was enabled, dropped packets included.

To try it interactively: the register simulator on the site page [Specification → Try it: the register file](https://tamirgabgab.github.io/Qcom-Mentoring/dut/spec/#try-it-the-register-file), or in the offline map `docs/downloads/yapp_project_map.html` (click the registers block inside the DUT).
